DIY 5-Gallon Water Filter

Free guide — part of the Ozark Prepper library

A 5-gallon bucket filter is a simple way to make cloudy river or rainwater clearer and safer to drink. It is not a full treatment system. You still need to boil or add a clean disinfectant. This book shows you the build and the limits.

What a bucket filter does

  • Job one: make water clearer. The filter takes the dirt out. It takes the small bits of mud, sand, and leaves out.
  • Job two: make water safer. A good filter can remove some germs. But no bucket filter removes all germs.

What a bucket filter does NOT do

  • Remove all bacteria
  • Remove all viruses
  • Remove chemicals
  • Remove salt
  • Remove heavy metals
  • Make unsafe water safe

Safety first: Drinking unsafe water can make you very sick. It can kill you. Read this warning twice. Never skip the boiling step. Never use a filter for bad water.
